title: Pakistani National Nazir Sadhir Detained After Inadvertent Border Crossing Near Kanachak, Jammu
detail: The Border Security Force apprehended Nazir Sadhir, a resident of Luni Pundra village in Sialkot, Pakistan, after he crossed the International Border into the Kanachak area of Jammu district on September 3, 2026. Officials said questioning established he was a resident of a Pakistani border village who had mistakenly strayed into Indian territory rather than a suspected infiltrator or agent. The BSF held a flag meeting with Pakistan Rangers at the Golpattan Border Out-Post, and Sadhir was subsequently handed over and repatriated to Pakistan, with the handover reported by Indian outlets on September 7. Officials characterized the episode as a routine inadvertent-crossing case, not a security breach.
